title: Biomechanical and Tomographic Outcomes in Pediatric Keratoconus Treated with Conventional Epithelium-Off Corneal Collagen Cross-Linking

groups.description: 28 eyes of 23 patients aged 13-18 years with progressive keratoconus (Amsler-Krumeich stages I-IV, Kmax below 65.0 D), all paediatric keratoconus eyes treated at the centre in 2019-2023; conventional Dresden epithelium-off CXL, riboflavin 0.1% with dextran 20% for 30 minutes, UVA 3 mW/cm2 for 30 minutes (5.4 J/cm2); single-centre observational cohort, visits at baseline, 6, 12 and 24 months

exclusions.reason: the table gives the absolute series, which is used instead of the change
duplicates the baseline cell of Table 2; Table 2 is cited

exclusions.what: Table 4 repeated-measures ANOVA statistics and Kmax-SP-A1 correlations
exclusions.reason: test statistics, p-values and correlations are not admissible values

exclusions.what: post-24-month course of three retreated eyes and one keratoplasty indication (Results text)
exclusions.reason: events after the tabulated follow-up; no Kmax values tabulated after 24 months

notes: Three eyes were retreated at about 3 years and one patient later had a keratoplasty indication; these events occurred after the 24-month visit, the tabulated values up to 24 months precede them, and the authors kept these eyes in the 24-month analysis.
Inclusion required the ability to comply with follow-up through 24 months; the cohort is all 28 paediatric keratoconus eyes treated at the centre during 2019-2023, so no larger treated group exists.
Table 2 also gives UCVA, BCVA, SP-A1 and thinnest pachymetry; Table 3 gives Corvis ST indices (DA, A1T, A2T, HC radius) and BAD-D (not extracted).
